reason: v4.72.1 closes a silent fail-open in Claude Code enforcement: every DashClaw hook installer wrote the pretool hook timeout as 3600000 - a milliseconds value in a field Claude Code reads as SECONDS. seconds*1000 overflows the harness's 32-bit timer, so the timer fires immediately, the harness cancels the still-running hook, and the tool call proceeds - block decisions and approval waits were never enforced (decisions still landed in the ledger, which masked it). Fixed to 3660s across scripts/install-hooks.mjs, the Claude Code plugin hooks.json (plugin 2.15.1), the CLI installer (@dashclaw/cli 0.7.2), hooks/settings.json, and the docs/guide examples. Found while investigating why require_approval writes proceeded without operator approval.
